name: Airflow
author: Madhav Baliga
description: Airflow around and through your design on a voxel lattice (lattice Boltzmann D3Q19 with a Smagorinsky closure). Free stream or fans in, flow per vent, dead zones, speed, pressure and streamlines. WebGPU, else CPU. An estimate; natural convection with conducting solids is experimental.

analyses.label: Airflow
analyses.description: Air speed, flow through each vent, dead zones and streamlines. Set the air speed under Conditions (ambient) or add a fan with the set-airflow tool, then pick the resolution. Natural convection (mode) adds the heat sources and the conduction of the bodies, and is experimental: it never decides a pass or fail.

settings.label: Resolution
settings.tip: Sets the voxel size so the lattice has about this many cells (the whole box, margin included): draft 262 144, normal 1 000 000, fine 2 097 152 (128 cubed) on a laptop GPU; 32 768, 110 592 and 262 144 (64 cubed) on a phone; 16 000, 40 000 and 100 000 without WebGPU. Vents narrower than about three voxels are poorly resolved. The voxel size is shown in the result.

settings.label: Compute
settings.tip: Auto uses WebGPU when the browser offers it and the lattice is big enough to benefit; the CPU solver is the fallback and uses much smaller lattices. Natural convection runs on the CPU.

settings.label: Mode
settings.tip: Forced: a free stream and/or fans drive the air (an estimate). Natural: buoyancy from the heat sources of the Conditions, coupled to the conduction of the bodies (experimental, CPU only).

settings.label: Flow direction
settings.tip: The direction the free stream blows in. The model sits in a box: the upstream face and the sides carry the free-stream speed, the downstream face is open at gauge pressure 0.

settings.label: Air speed
settings.tip: The free-stream speed. 0 takes the air speed of the Conditions (ambient). With 0 and no fan the analysis says nothing drives the air.

settings.label: Flow-throughs
settings.tip: How many times the air crosses the box before the result is taken. The run stops early once the kinetic energy settles, or at the time limit.

settings.label: Time limit
settings.tip: The run is stopped after this long and says that it did not settle. The CPU fallback is slow: expect about a million cell updates per 0.1 s.

settings.label: Dead-zone threshold
settings.tip: Interior air slower than this fraction of the reference speed (the free stream, else the mean speed through the inflow vents) counts as dead.

agentTools.label: Airflow settings
agentTools.description: Set the Airflow settings in the project: quality, backend, mode (forced|natural), flow_dir, speed_ms, margin_mm, flow_throughs, max_seconds, smagorinsky, min_tau, dead_frac, streamlines (count), h_mm, fans [{center [x,y,z] mm, dir, radius_mm, dp_Pa, q_m3s?}]. Only given keys change. Does not run it.
